claim.text: Sinusoidal positional encoding uses sin(pos / 10000^{2i/d}), so nearby positions have a similar encoding.

spec.explain: Illustrative toy of arXiv 1706.03762 sinusoidal positional encoding: the curve shows encoding similarity falling as position distance grows, with the smooth nearby-position limit as its condition.

questions.q: Predict how alike encodings stay if delta is 50 before moving anything?
Is it true that any i like 4 always keeps nearby positions similar before moving i?
What do you expect from a larger d like 256 for slow dimensions?
How would you describe nearby similarity if delta is 2 without computing it?

widget.draw: function draw(ctx, state, t) { var w = state.w; var h = state.h; var delta = state.delta; var ii = state.i; var d = state.d; function fmt(v) { return Math.round(v * 100) / 100; } function divr() { return Math.pow(10000, 2 * ii / d); } var D = divr(); var phase = delta / D; var sim = Math.cos(phase); var x0 = 52; var y0 = 30; var pw = 480; var ph = 220; function X(dd) { return x0 + dd / 100 * pw; } function Y(s) { return y0 + (1 - s) / 2 * ph; } ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h); ctx.fillStyle = "#f6f3ec"; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h); ctx.strokeStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.strokeRect(x0, y0, pw, ph); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0, Y(0)); ctx.lineTo(x0 + pw, Y(0)); ctx.strokeStyle = "#c9bda9"; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.stroke(); ctx.beginPath(); var k = 0; var dd = 0; var s = 0; for (k = 0; k <= 120; k++) { dd = k / 120 * 100; s = Math.cos(dd / D); if (k === 0) { ctx.moveTo(X(dd), Y(s)); } else { ctx.lineTo(X(dd), Y(s)); } } ctx.strokeStyle = "#1f4b99"; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.stroke(); var mx = X(delta); var my = Y(sim); ctx.strokeStyle = "#c4512c"; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(mx, y0); ctx.lineTo(mx, y0 + ph); ctx.stroke(); ctx.fillStyle = "#c4512c"; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(mx, my, 6, 0, 6.2832); ctx.fill(); ctx.fillStyle = "#1d1a16"; ctx.font = "13px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("similarity vs distance", x0, 18); ctx.font = "12px sans-serif"; ctx.fillText("phase = " + fmt(phase), 52, 296); ctx.fillText("similarity = " + fmt(sim), 52, 316); ctx.fillText("delta 0 to 100, cos curve", 320, 296); ctx.fillText("i sets frequency via d", 320, 316); }
